source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Fuel Tank and Exhaust Systems, p.8-15

procedures.title: Muffler, rear exhaust and tail pipes: replace
steps: Remove the U bolts at both rear tail pipes and take off the tail pipes.
Loosen the U bolt nuts and separate the system at the crossmember tube.
Remove the rear muffler bracket screws and slide the muffler system rearward.
Measure the service muffler's pipe end first, then cut the exhaust pipe near the muffler leaving enough for 1-1/2" of engagement into the service muffler pipe.
Fit the new muffler and secure it with new clamps, nuts facing the rear of the car and set 90° to the sawcuts in the service muffler pipe.
Replace any fatigued bracket insulators (tire carcass mountings).
If the tail pipe bezel is damaged, remove its 3 screws and replace it.

specs.what: exhaust pipe engagement into service muffler

procedures.title: Front exhaust pipes: replace
steps: Remove the pipe-to-manifold nuts, extensions and packings.
Remove the clamps just ahead of the transmission crossmember and take out the front pipe.
To install, join the front pipe to the rear pipe, then attach it at the manifold with new packings and nuts.
Clean the manifold stud threads before fitting new nuts.
Check exhaust system clearances before tightening nuts and clamps.
